metadata.subject: Environment and Ecology
metadata.description: UPSC Prelims Environment & Ecology question grammar dataset for few-shot prompting and style conditioning.

patterns.title: Concept Definition / Single-Choice
patterns.explanation: Tests core ecological and environmental concepts like biomes, ecosystems, pollution types.

example_questions.question: Which one of the following best describes an ecosystem?
options: (a) A group of organisms of the same species
(b) A community of organisms interacting with each other and their environment
(c) A genetic pool of a population

distractor_rationales.(a): Only species grouping, not environment interaction.
distractor_rationales.(d): Food chain is part of ecosystem, not definition.

patterns.title: Multi-Statement Evaluation
patterns.explanation: Evaluates ecological, environmental and pollution statements.

example_questions.question:
Consider the following:
1. Ozone in the stratosphere absorbs harmful UV radiation.
2. Ground-level ozone is a greenhouse gas.
3. Ozone depletion leads to higher skin cancer risks.
Which statements are correct?
example_questions.pattern_notes: Tests understanding of ozone roles at different levels.

distractor_rationales.(c): Statement 2 is incorrect in this context.

patterns.title: Match-the-Pair
patterns.explanation: Pairs environmental terms with definitions or features.

example_questions.question:
Match the following:
List I
1. CFCs
2. Greenhouse Gas
3. BOD

List II
(a) Oxygen depletion indicator
(b) Methane
(c) Ozone depleting substance
Select the correct answer:

patterns.title: Assertion–Reason Type
patterns.explanation: Tests relationships between environmental processes and outcomes.

example_questions.question:
Assertion (A): Coral bleaching increases with rising sea temperatures.
Reason (R): Corals expel symbiotic algae when stressed by high temperature.
Which is correct?
options: (a) A and R correct and R explains A
(b) Both correct but R not explain A
example_questions.pattern_notes: Standard ecology process linking cause and effect.

example_questions.question: Which one of the following is a renewable energy source?

distractor_rationales.(d): Energy source but not renewable in the strict sense.

patterns.title: Current-Linked Environment MCQ
patterns.explanation: Uses recent environmental developments (summits, policy, indices) to test core ecology.

example_questions.question: Recently, India submitted its updated Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement. NDCs are related to:
example_questions.pattern_notes: Links policy action with environmental conceptual test.
